# Databricks Hacks Provider

Manages Databricks custom resources. The provider can be initialized with authentication settings only; SQL warehouse IDs are configured on individual metric view resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5"
  required_providers {
    databricks-hacks = {
      source = "mateuszboryn/databricks-hacks"
    }
  }
}

provider "databricks-hacks" {
  host = var.databricks_host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Databricks workspace URL. Falls back to unified authentication configuration.
- `profile` (String) Databricks CLI configuration profile name.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Databricks personal access token. Falls back to unified authentication configuration.
